subject: POC sprint: calendar shift, secure visitor passes and streaming policy
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@paywell.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@paywell.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC timing and format

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at PayWell liked the throughput numbers but we need to shift the hands-on sprint by one week to accommodate a product release on our side. Would Redwood be available the week of June 26 for a half-day hands-on session?

Two quick items for confirmation before we lock the date:
- We have a mixed footprint of onsite folks (5) and remote engineers (6). Is hybrid streaming + local room OK?
- We need to record the session for our internal compliance team. Any restrictions on recording/streaming from Redwood?

Can you also confirm load-test expectations (concurrency during the exercise) so our infra lead can provision a short window of extra capacity?

Appreciate a quick reply so I can get the calendar updated.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Sr. Product Manager, PayWell
elena.ortiz@paywell.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC timing and format — need room + recorder policy details

Marissa / Soojin,

Forwarding PayWell's note — they want to push the sprint to week of Jun 26 and will be hybrid (5 onsite / 6 remote). Two asks we need to address before I get back to them:

1) Site logistics: room booking (capacity for 10+), visitor passes for 5 external attendees, AV (HD streaming + backup local recording), and room contingency if the main lab is in use.
2) Security/compliance constraint: they explicitly asked about recording policy. We need a short-template response that covers: where recordings are stored, retention policy, and whether participants can request redaction.
3) Load test window: they want to know recommended concurrency during the hands-on prompt routing/load test. Suggest numbers or a plan so they can provision infra.

Attaching: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf and loadtest_plan.xlsx (draft) — please review and update the concurrency guidance (Soojin) and confirm room & visitor-pass process (Marissa).

I can pick this up with Elena after we have answers.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC timing and format — need room + recorder policy details

Marcus,

I can book a hybrid lab on June 27 (Tuesday) or June 28 (Wednesday) — both half-day windows (9:00–13:00 PT). Details:

- Rooms: Lab B (12 seats + HDMI/DisplayLink) or Conference 4A (10 seats + Cisco room kit). Lab B is preferred for hands-on since it has local GPUs and dedicated network.
- Visitor passes: For external visitors we need names + company + DOB (for building security) 48 hours in advance. I can generate electronic day-passes that they can show at front desk.
- AV & streaming: AV team can stream to a private Zoom link and simultaneously record to our secure S3 bucket. Retention default is 90 days; for PayWell we can extend to 12 months with their written request. Redaction requests are manual today — we can provide timestamps and handle redaction on a time & materials basis.
- Recording access: Recordings are stored on encrypted S3; we can provide a time-limited presigned link to external recipients.

Action items for me: I'll reserve Lab B for Jun 27 09:00–13:00 PT tentatively (pending Marcus confirmation) and request visitor passes once Elena confirms attendee names.

Quick calendar question: Do we want the session repeated as two parallel tracks (on-site hands-on + 2 remote breakout rooms) or single session with remote participants watching while we route prompts to them? My recommendation: single coordinated session with remote breakout for hands-on pairing.

Marissa
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC timing and format — need room + recorder policy details

Notes on prompts/routing and load test (cc'd loadtest_plan.xlsx):

- Recommended concurrency: start with 8 concurrent user sessions during the hands-on demos, ramp to 20 for the dedicated 10-minute load check. That aligns with our continuous batching defaults for the models we're serving.
- KV cache and routing: if PayWell will use turn-based chat routing (multi-tool calls), we should provision for slightly higher token peaks — see kv-routing-checklist.md attached.
- Prompt review: ask PayWell to share a 20–30 prompt seed set (anonymized) so we can pre-run them through the quantized variant to anticipate latency/quality regressions.
- Fallback plan: if real-time latency goes above SLO, we'll fall back to a queued batch mode for non-interactive parts and notify the group.

I'll also prepare a short bullet doc (kv-routing-checklist.md) describing the observability hooks to capture during the session.

Soojin
Platform Engineer, Inference Ops
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@paywell.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@paywell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-16T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC timing and format — final plan and calendar invite

Elena / Rajiv,

Thanks — we can do the hybrid hands-on sprint on Tuesday, June 27, 09:00–13:00 PT in Lab B. Summary of commitments:

- Logistics (Marissa): Lab B reserved, electronic visitor passes required 48h in advance (names + company + DOB). AV will stream to a private Zoom and record to encrypted S3. Default retention is 90 days; we can extend to 12 months on request.
- Load tests (Soojin): Plan attached — start at 8 concurrent users, ramp to 20 for a 10-minute peak check. Please share an anonymized 20–30 prompt seed set by EOD Monday so we can pre-run quality checks.
- Recording & access (Marissa): We will provide a time-limited presigned link post-session. Redaction is manual — if you need it, let us know which timestamps/segments.

Next steps:
1) Elena — confirm attendee list (first & last name + DOB for onsite passes) and which participants should get recording access.
2) Rajiv — share a 20–30 anonymized prompt seed set by 2028-06-19 EOD (Soojin will pre-run).
3) Marcus — I'll send the Zoom + calendar invite once we have attendee names.

Proposed calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd-ef12-3456 (I will send formal invite once attendee info is in).

If anything changes with your release schedule we can slide to Wed 6/28 — please let me know no later than Monday.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(Attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, loadtest_plan.xlsx, kv-routing-checklist.md)
